All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class J3DGetterException extends com.jaiva.errors.InterpreterException.WtfAreYouDoingException
This is not a J3Engine error which would make use of J3DError and those, this is an error of malformed input into J3D from Jaiva but it's the jaiva script's fault, hence its a jaiva facing error
